name: AeroTab
description:
A 3D Alt+Tab window switcher in four styles.

Escuro and Área de trabalho: the selected window faces you in the middle and the others line up on both sides, tilted like the walls of a corridor, with a floor reflection (on black, or on your blurred wallpaper). Pilha 3D: the windows are stacked in depth, the active one in front. Carrossel 3D: a curved Cover Flow row with the neighbours turned almost sideways.

Alt+Tab moves forward, Alt+Shift+Tab moves back, releasing Alt switches to the selected window, Esc cancels. Arrow keys, mouse wheel and clicks also work, and the X button closes the selected window. Turning AeroTab off (or the extension) brings back the default GNOME Alt+Tab.
